title: Cohomological Inverses and Fractional Jet Spectra in Banach-Space Normally Hyperbolic Persistence
content: We establish persistence of normally hyperbolic invariant manifolds in Banach spaces through the cohomological operator \( \mathcal A\zeta=\zeta\circ f-B\zeta \). The framework decomposes into linear cohomological inversion, HPS invariant-section matching, roughness of exponential dichotomies, Perron constructions, and regularity obstructions in induced jet cocycles. The main new analytic contribution is a fractional jet-spectrum theorem: bounded invertibility of \( \mathcal A \) on \( C^{k,\alpha} \) follows from a subunit spectral radius of the exact Green summand operators on Hölder jet bundles. We prove a periodic jet-resonance obstruction to \( C^k \)-surjectivity, a two-sided invariant-section theorem with explicit graph transform, and corrected extension architectures for noncompact, nonautonomous, parabolic, delay, quasilinear, and boundary settings.
